description: Server-side VanillaBackport addon for NeoForge 1.21.1 that boosts a Happy Ghast while its driver holds a Ghast Tear.

mods.name: FastGhast
mods.description:
While riding your Happy Ghast, hold up a Ghast Tear and your little companion
will unleash its full power. A VanillaBackport addon for Minecraft 1.21.1.

releases.notes:
## FastGhast v0.2.0

First stable release of FastGhast, tested on a NeoForge 1.21.1 server.

### Features

- Boosts a Happy Ghast while its driver holds a Ghast Tear in either hand.
- Changes `FLYING_SPEED` from `0.05` to `0.10`.
- Reaches approximately 14.4 blocks per second while boosted.
- Only the driver activates the boost; other passengers are ignored.
- Removes the boost immediately when the tear is put away or the driver dismounts.
- Does not consume the Ghast Tear.
- Runs entirely on the server.

### Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.222 or newer within the 21.1 branch
- VanillaBackport 1.1.6.3 or newer
- Platform 1.2.11.4 or newer

### Installation

Place `fastghast-0.2.0.jar` in the server's `mods` directory alongside
VanillaBackport and Platform.
